description.value: Lamajoun is a family-owned Mediterranean bakery in Richmond specializing in lahmajoun — a centuries-old flatbread dish topped with seasoned meat, rooted in Armenian and Middle Eastern culinary tradition. Everything is made from scratch using locally sourced greens and vegetables, premium meats, and no preservatives, MSG, or palm oil. Located in a commercial unit along River Road, it offers a distinctive scratch-baked stop for cyclists exploring Richmond's waterfront area.
